purpose: Resolve the frozen 29 public Equipment image holds from the current official CN APK without reopening Equipment semantics or changing the existing verified 344 assets.

officialApk.readMethod: HTTP Range ZIP entry reads; full APK download not required

required: exact Texture2D stem exists in the authoritative root bundle
decoded image is RGBA with alpha
legacy frozen PNG comparison is recorded
normalized RGBA mean absolute byte difference is <= 0.02
representativeProof.reason: The current official APK stores these icons as ETC2_RGBA8 GPU-compressed Texture2D data. Exact decoded pixel/hash parity against legacy uncompressed PNG exports is not a valid invariant. Legacy comparison is validation-only and must never choose or JOIN an asset.
representativeProof.identityStillDeterminedBy: equipmentId -> full ConfigData icon locator -> authoritative root bundle -> exact Texture2D stem
